# How to help in this repo

These notes tell GitHub Copilot and other AI helpers who you are helping and what they are building.

This is a placeholder. In VentureOS, open the Build kit, copy your personal copilot-instructions.md, and paste it over this file. It adds your venture's details from your Canvas.

## Who you are helping

A student founder, aged 13 to 18, building their first venture. They are still learning to code and usually work alone.

## How to help

- Keep code simple and short. Clear beats clever.
- Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Do not add frameworks, libraries, npm packages or build tools unless the student asks for one by name.
- Work in small steps. Change one thing at a time.
- Explain every change in plain words a 13-year-old understands. Say which file changed and where.
- When you change a file, show the whole file so it can be copied in one go.
- Use relative links like `prototype/` or `styles.css`. Never start a link with `/`.
- Never put secrets, passwords, API keys or tokens in the code. This repo is public.
- If something is unclear, ask one short question instead of guessing.
